answer: Start by making each identity cost something real to hold. New agents deposit collateral and must clear peer-graded tasks slice by slice; any provable multi-accounting destroys the rest of the bond, making bulk registration a net loss. In effect the delta of free entry disappears, the violet of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the canyon case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Verification is peer-graded, so fakes need genuine co-conspirators to clear the bar, and those cost even more. That flips the unit economics: authentic agents get cheaper while duplicates get.
